pick.headline: Israeli helicopters kill Hizballah leader Abbas Musawi
pick.summary: On 16 February 1992 Israeli helicopter gunships attacked the motorcade of Hizballah Secretary General Abbas al-Musawi in southern Lebanon, killing him with his wife and son.
pick.significance: The targeted killing was followed by the bombing of the Israeli embassy in Buenos Aires a month later. Musawi's successor was Hassan Nasrallah.
